hpi: Children with lead toxicity may present with abdominal pain, vomiting, and altered mental status. The diagnosis is made by measuring blood lead levels. Treatment includes chelation therapy for severe cases. It is important to consider lead exposure in children with unexplained symptoms, especially in those with known risk factors.
